description: MemoryStatus and CleanupStatus live inside the actor class with hand-rolled to_json/from_json (~80 lines). Project convention already keeps DTOs in src/dtos/ (api_responses.cr). Move MemoryStatus, CleanupStatus, PressureLevel, CleanupPriority to src/dtos/memory_dtos.cr and replace hand-rolled serialization with JSON::Serializable (from_json parsing then also becomes automatic and consistent - note both structs also accept a missing last_gc_time/last_priority key inconsistently via obj[...]?.try).
title: Move memory DTOs to src/dtos and use JSON::Serializable
